$comment: Known real builds of the FD3S RX-7 (BUILD_PROMPT 6.5), all on stock-port 13B-REW engines. Chosen before running the model (docs/research-notes/part2b.md). Excluded: ported engines (street port, bridge port), shop-rebuilt engines whose porting isn't stated, a 402 rwhp EFR 8374 sheet with no intercooler or rpm on it, and E85 cars with fuel-pump limits. Mustang sheets carry an estimated reading factor (standards/dynos.json); the Dynojet sheet is the firmer check. Research: docs/research/part2b/known-builds-mazda-rx-7-fd3s.json.
